eventdata.scriptBlockText: # ============================================================================= # generar_trafico_windows.ps1 â€” Trafico de red realista desde la estacion # Windows miembro de dominio. Emula a un empleado usando un equipo corporativo: # navegacion web, acceso a recursos compartidos SMB, autenticacion de dominio # (Kerberos/LDAP contra el DC), consultas DNS y actividad de proceso normal. # Genera telemetria Sysmon + logs de Windows + eventos de AD legitimos, para # que la medicion de falsos positivos sea significativa. # # Uso:  powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File generar_trafico_windows.ps1 [DURACION_MIN] # ============================================================================= param([int]$DuracionMin = 30)  $ErrorActionPreference = \"SilentlyContinue\" $ProgressPreference = \"SilentlyContinue\" $fin = (Get-Date).AddMinutes($DuracionMin)  $DC_IP   = if ($env:DC_IP)  { $env:DC_IP }  else { \"10.0.10.20\" } $WEB_IP  = if ($env:WEB_IP) { $env:WEB_IP } else { \"10.0.10.10\" } $DOMAIN  = if ($env:DOMAIN) { $env:DOMAIN } else { \"empresa.local\" }  $sitios = @(   \"https://www.icesi.edu.co\",\"https://es.wikipedia.org\",\"https://www.microsoft.com\",   \"https://www.google.com\",\"https://www.github.com\",\"https://www.python.org\",   \"https://outlook.office365.com\",\"https://www.cloudflare.com\" ) $dominios = @(\"google.com\",\"microsoft.com\",\"github.com\",\"windowsupdate.com\",   \"office365.com\",\"wikipedia.org\",\"amazonaws.com\",\"icesi.edu.co\") $webPaths = @(\"/\",\"/index.php?id=1\",\"/index.php?id=5\",\"/index.php?id=42\",\"/index.php?id=2\")  function Log($m) { Write-Host (\"  [{0}][win-ws-01] {1}\" -f (Get-Date -Format HH:mm:ss), $m) } function Activo { (Get-Date) -lt $fin } function Espera { Start-Sleep -Seconds (Get-Random -Minimum 5 -Maximum 22) }  Log \"Inicio trafico realista Windows ($DuracionMin min)\" [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12  while (Activo) {   switch (Get-Random -Minimum 0 -Maximum 10) {     {$_ -in 0,1,2} {       $s = $sitios | Get-Random       try { Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $s -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 8 | Out-Null; Log \"web $s\" } catch {}     }     {$_ -in 3,4} {       $p = $webPaths | Get-Random       try { Invoke-WebRequest -Uri (\"http://{0}{1}\" -f $WEB_IP,$p) -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5 | Out-Null; Log \"portal $p\" } catch {}     }     5 {       $d = $dominios | Get-Random       Resolve-DnsName -Name $d -Server $DC_IP -QuickTimeout | Out-Null; Log \"dns $d\"     }     6 {       # Acceso a recurso compartido del DC (SYSVOL/NETLOGON) y del web-server       Get-ChildItem \"\\\\$DC_IP\\SYSVOL\" | Out-Null       Get-ChildItem (\"\\\\{0}\\compartido\" -f $WEB_IP) | Out-Null       Log \"smb share\"     }     7 {       # Autenticacion / consulta de dominio (Kerberos + LDAP contra el DC)       klist | Out-Null       nltest /dsgetdc:$DOMAIN | Out-Null       ([ADSISearcher]\"(objectClass=user)\").FindAll() | Out-Null       Log \"auth dominio (kerberos/ldap)\"     }     8 {       # Actividad de proceso normal de un usuario       Get-Process | Out-Null; Get-Service | Where-Object Status -eq Running | Out-Null       cmd /c \"whoami /groups\" | Out-Null       Log \"actividad local\"     }     9 {       gpupdate /target:computer | Out-Null; Log \"gpupdate\"     }   }   Espera } Log \"Trafico realista Windows finalizado.\"
